name: Alcabón (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Alcabón (two wolves on yellow and a pillory on blue).
history: The symbols of Alcabón are the crimson flag typical of Castilian municipalities and the traditional arms with two wolves and the pillory, crowned with the Spanish royal crown; they were officially approved on 21 July 1995 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 4 August 1995. The flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, crimson, bearing at the centre the arms at half the height of the cloth.
